title: The Block 2025: Emma & Ben's Pregnancy Sparks Karl vs. Scott Showdown
text:
Emma and Ben from “The Block” are expecting a baby boy, with the exciting proclamation made in episode 20 of the show. The couple, who have been together for 14 years and married for three, shared their joyous news with “Today” hosts Karl Stefanovic and Sarah Abo, sparking a playful debate between the two personalities over a potential baby name.
Baby joy sparks kind feud during their appearance on the morning show, Stefanovic playfully asked about “little Karlos,” referencing a potential name for the baby. Ben quickly interjected, warning Stefanovic that “The Block” host Scotty Cam had already claimed dibs on naming the child after him. Stefanovic humorously retorted, “Scotty can go jump, mate!”
Karl Stefanovic and Scott Cam The Block 2025 pregnancy Did you know? Emma, 33, and Ben, 32, found out they were pregnant on the same day they were invited to participate in “The Block.”
Emma, who is 29 weeks pregnant, described her pregnancy as “smooth sailing so far.” She shared, “I’m feeling really good. I think I’ve been very lucky I’ve had a great pregnancy.” The couple shared their emotional journey, with Ben admitting, “This news is huge. This is the start of the next chapter of our lives.” He added, “Starting a family, it’s something we’ve been talking about for a year probably, and now it’s happening.”
